title: For host "blaze8-12" and completed migrations, list each instance’s display
question: For host "blaze8-12" and completed migrations, list each instance’s display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average completed migrations per host; also include, for the same instances, the completed migration rows whose migration id is greater than the overall average migration id (within this host’s completed migrations), showing migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, network info, and the status-partitioned running average migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.display_name,
    i.hostname,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.vcpus,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.status AS migration_status,
    m.source_compute,
    m.dest_compute,
    c.network_info
  FROM instances AS i

  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND m.status = 'completed'

),

  SELECT hc.host, hc.completed_migrations, AVG(hc.completed_migrations) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host

  SELECT AVG(m.id) AS avg_migration_id

  JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid

  SELECT
    b.*,

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status AS migration_status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute,
         m.dest_host AS network_info,
         i.display_name, i.hostname, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid AS instance_uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status='completed' AND (m.source_compute='blaze8-12' OR m.dest_compute='blaze8-12')
),
host_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_completed,
         AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS avg_completed_per_host,
         AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id
  FROM base
),
inst AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT instance_uuid, display_name, hostname, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus,
         MAX(migration_status) AS migration_status
  FROM base
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT inst.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY instance_uuid) AS rn
  FROM inst
),
maxwin AS (
  SELECT r.instance_uuid,
         MAX(b.migration_id) AS max_migration_id_window
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN base b ON b.instance_uuid = r.instance_uuid
  JOIN ranked r2 ON r2.rn BETWEEN r.rn AND r.rn + 2
  WHERE b.instance_uuid = r2.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY r.instance_uuid
)
SELECT r.display_name, r.hostname, r.vm_state, r.memory_mb, r.vcpus, r.instance_uuid,
       r.migration_status, mw.max_migration_id_window,
       hs.total_completed, hs.avg_completed_per_host,
       b.migration_id, b.migration_status, b.source_compute, b.dest_compute,
       b.display_name AS mig_display_name, b.network_info,
       AVG(b.migration_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.migration_status ORDER BY b.migration_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_migration_id
FROM ranked r
CROSS JOIN host_stats hs
JOIN maxwin mw ON mw.instance_uuid = r.instance_uuid
JOIN base b ON b.instance_uuid = r.instance_uuid AND b.migration_id > hs.avg_migration_id
ORDER BY r.instance_uuid, b.migration_id
